title: Student Support and Course Feedback Assistant (MODIFIED pack for comparison)
target_definition: Set needs_support to 1 when G3 is below 10, otherwise 0. G3 is the final grade in the source data. The threshold of 10 is a modelling definition for this exercise and is not an institutional promotion rule.
image_source: MNIST digits (different subset, mlxtend) made to look like rough scans: rotation, shift, blur, noise
feedback_origin: NEW authored classroom examples with reference labels; not a real survey

modification.purpose: Check how results change on a different dataset; not for the final submission
modification.main_csv: 520 SYNTHETIC records for a different school, made from the real records with lower marks, more failures and noise; split 364/78/78
modification.images_npz: different MNIST subset in a rough-scan style (rotation up to 15 degrees, shift, blur, noise)
modification.feedback_csv: 40 new authored comments: 16 negative, 14 positive, 10 neutral
